text: This report recommends updates to Toronto Atmospheric Fund’s Executive Compensation Policy, responding to City Council’s 2023 direction to City Agencies and Corporations to amend their organization’s compensation policy to align with the updated Guiding Principles for the Development of Senior Executive Policies at City Agencies and Corporations.

The Board of Directors of the Toronto Atmospheric Fund: 1. Approved the updated Executive Compensation Policy in Attachment 1 to the report (January 29, 2024) from the Chief Executive Officer, Toronto Atmospheric Fund.
